contentHtml:
[vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text css=””]There is a wide variety of cafés at Woodlands with tasty meals, drinks and delicious snacks.

Ray’s Diner

Rays Diner is situated on the middle floor of the Empire of the Sea Dragon so you don’t have to stop playing for long to grab refreshments. With hot meals and quick snacks, it makes a great lunchtime stop. The balcony seating area offers good views of the soft play area so you can enjoy a coffee or cold drink whilst keeping watch of the kids playing.

Cosmic Café

Fast food at its best for your day out in Devon. Takeaway or take a break from the action in the undercover seating area. Tasty food at good value prices.

Courtyard Café

Tucked away in the shelter of the Big Animal Barn you will find the Courtyard Café. The family menu is ideal for our guests who have time to relax over a coffee and a yummy cake.

Love’s Grove Café

Nestled under a canopy of trees between Golden Bear City and the Watercoasters this action-packed spot offers amazing views of the surrounding rides. With hot or cold meals available, Love’s Grove Café is a popular lunchtime destination for guests.

Ice Cream Kiosks

There are plenty of places to stop and get ice-cream and drinks in the playzones throughout the park. With ice-creams from Yard Farm and Carte D’or you’ll be struggling to choose between all the delicious flavours. Carte D’or Ice creams are available from Loves Grove Cafe and Rays Diner.

Please note: Ice cream shacks are cash only.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row]

Courtyard Café

Tucked away in the shelter of the Big Animal Barn you will find the Courtyard Café. The family menu is ideal for our guests who have time to relax over a coffee and a yummy cake or who are looking for a quick family meal before heading for the big Tractor Ride. There are hot & cold drinks to suit all tastes at very reasonable prices.
